risk_summary: The excerpt is generally transparent and well quantified, with detailed year-over-year net interest income, yield, funding-cost, and loan-balance data. Risk disclosures are largely standard, but reliance on estimates, purchased-loan accretion, declining yields, and discretionary FHLB stock redemptions represent relevant credit and liquidity considerations. The tone is neutral to modestly confident rather than crisis-oriented.
